name: Steve Scalise
subject: I feel like I need to say I’m sorry...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
| I need to apologize to you.
I'm sorry, truly I am.
I'm sorry that some people accuse you of not being MAGA if you don't make a donation.
I'm sorry that some people lie to you about who they are to try to trick you into donating.
And I'm sorry that many folks don't even show their appreciation when you do donate.
It drives me crazy that people try to treat you like that, and it's important to hear why I do things differently.
First things first.
This is Majority Leader Steve Scalise.
Secondly, I want to thank you for all of the support you've given to the GOP over the years; it really means a lot.
But right now we're staring down some concerning numbers, and it has my team and I really worried.
The Democrats are currently unloading 100 million dollars into 35 GOP seats to obliterate our House Majority once and for all, and here is the truth: Right now, we simply don't have the funds to fully fund our campaign operations in all 35 races.
[So the simple truth is that I need your help before our House Majority is a thing of the past.](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=74d107f48a48411d96754a7ac4546805&_e=eK1oRY-N9Z9lNSU5vwqdiCk3DApVyPvyQldDrKfjLVmq0pOzabudQvpsS2SVMPdAbWFSO29Ro0dxg-Ey3JmdbP-bdwR8_-zodV1sovQknIixCR20B7ycsSB4DuB8SnKemxSs1P1SHduuVjIIsxGiAQwK8XBccXRHUIGs-w9sZc_3Xr23bzWBpKlmIFWP9oqw4eDxL97_LRXstrCbD1t5vtHzFENFRc6pmIDkKyjw-JALirFJixr5W-QrD4W9LhdUAdBs20PIkABu-W3kxc3v0btZSKyNie4X1GRh3LoLr3ZcXEpjCmdJISSNK8hnx8oSHGnJE4mG5qaZdXv0dDYVicAu66v0YMm-T7LoSi0neHhN8uquEAlqgZI3ZhXTTQio67b5Trrv3-1oquAH8Wtv_gW4lz87M4IXbeXIS2PsAlLh8CdwRla-54gHTtIjdFGP7OlskcYWELt_yI_OiDKHYERbDA0vcMId5YVN0xHmyH6zfJNGPQ9h-hs1tbm4HfuDWWosgk0Twtdi-dVF6zCG23qLEvKeqSoKbQEcgoBKqdZANuq5VWBp-wFrryAhPD88dBJwrE-VxDfvYkX0t6_XRnoXIZeEQ049VrrR5glHjX3fsMxZPbjo1Z3q-f6MRZsfKTUwsaVClAUFwEmvky_4VfleFVbvCP-R0eA766j6_oWlp5CL6XY1k0gAePv145XY)
If you can't afford to help right now, no problem. I won't hold that against you. Taking care of your loved ones always comes first. I will never question your Party loyalty or shame you for not making a donation.
HOWEVER - if you can make a donation, I promise not a single penny will go unnoticed, and it will go a long way to helping to save our House Majority.
Because right now we're facing down our critical end-of-month deadline, and it's looking like we'll fall well short of the goals that I set out.
[I’m sorry to be a bother, really I am, but are you willing to chip in just a few bucks to help us crush our major fundraising deadline?](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=74d107f48a48411d96754a7ac4546805&_e=eK1oRY-N9Z9lNSU5vwqdiCk3DApVyPvyQldDrKfjLVmq0pOzabudQvpsS2SVMPdAbWFSO29Ro0dxg-Ey3JmdbP-bdwR8_-zodV1sovQknIixCR20B7ycsSB4DuB8SnKemxSs1P1SHduuVjIIsxGiAQwK8XBccXRHUIGs-w9sZc_3Xr23bzWBpKlmIFWP9oqw4eDxL97_LRXstrCbD1t5vtHzFENFRc6pmIDkKyjw-JALirFJixr5W-QrD4W9LhdUFlcfQvKARKAPgYMkzt2XTCLOscOLqFVbP4pQ096iTrLF4HWR7zlZjTIYsCUEZR_JkBZeRlF-aoklv_C83F9hhqNbwrK1gKN_Gk-ZuILcZdsV1h-cCbsG1nXUjsAxrwr6fHdUUmI9xsYLjV7OSDuI84oM2TmheGqZjggCCTNPQvU3l2CIwyxENehChGXj0eDZQ76gd1IPybeMBivrXytMh4DAWLItBkVZL7X2FmGetFEbczgAQCgfQ4L--NYOcazeqfTKePQDeQEkcBRB3XM7Sn0OjWROlPQ0dlCqJS9VQCfphhXPpxYMy71d5wSVpBeTRxtgwNgFfUJ2UQfVcK9Yef3J5Rbe1xN7TjMD0teZcfAuGuaGE28Ues6BAfTnx9ZkU-9QBEGtWhjhLjT4c9-cM2G83Ewh7xXrwUWa-3KGlbU9VOeKmQVkZDdjxFAhago2)

body:
Every suppressive action these vengeful partisans take shows their true colors. For all their talk about election integrity, voter ID, and not harming eligible voters, closing legitimate polling places to make it harder to vote only has one logical end result.
Attacks by opponents of voting rights on young voters, mail-in ballots, early voting, and more aren't about integrity and fairness. It's about protecting their own power at any cost and tilting the playing field before the game has even been played.
We must stand up to stop them at every turn. RUSH $35 or more today to help us fight back in North Carolina and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052826_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: Amid protests, NC elections board rejects campus voting sites and Sunday voting in several counties [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052826_3&amount=25]
We're now facing the repercussions of the partisan election takeover laws that went into effect at the end of 2024, Team.
To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites on several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today to help every eligible voter cast their ballot >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052826_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

These new, highly partisan State Election Board members wouldn't even look the protestors in the eye or engage with their proposals. After the vote, Chairman Francis De Luca threatened to call the cops on students if they didn’t leave.
Need to better understand how this impacts young voters? Western Carolina University in Jackson County, for example, has had a polling place on campus since 2016 that’s been used in five general elections and four primaries, according to a document prepared for the board. The state board voted 3-2 to get rid of it.
Closing the campus voting site would not save money, but “ would create barriers to voting for young, rural residents ,” Jackson County Board member Betsy Swift told the state board. 64% of students don’t have vehicles to drive to the polling place, she said.
Without the on-campus site, the closest polling place for students will be a recreation center nearly two miles away. Students without transportation will have to walk along a four-lane highway and through a meadow to get there.
Voter suppression isn't just black and white photos of eligible voters being turned away from polling places. Voter suppression is making it harder for eligible voters to take part in our elections through onerous ID requirements, closing polling places, taking away voting locations, or ending mail-in voting. Every time someone makes it harder to cast your ballot, voters are suppressed.
It's not going to end until we stop them.

I’ve personally worked with Julia on crucial issues, such as securing the border, cutting your taxes, and lowering the cost of living. She’s as America First as it gets! As Senator, she’ll be a reliable vote for the SAVE America Act, President Trump’s nominees, and the entire agenda to Make America Great Again. [**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider joining my team at the end.**](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=ca10967e65334e0e859055ed4761a4c2&_e=iDoofNiSfBw6Yb9CtXQ2i6ATalEkIiZF95I8lwIZbqxl5DQZGzjjlkom9Mq9WE2mwJk3ixBgvk2veG4H2mETOxP9oC9Wvc4r8Lsbo6qKkmfHpzSo1uNReCJkQgJEC1IzjDntlVn3y5avZugkSv8IPbwAanhO9M4KbxYulv_61tIwqNEI5QV962OR486YUKJAr1kMvRSq_lm6hVsPzk71PmQpaeFU6i6yM9g8vqC7eOooBnAObNSaOB33fSLan-6LswJGWhZmF6rOJa-s_yFBewJQME7ohWdp1d1pwOTYWYFtQ5Uqfh-jiiNtnzaXFmeIiZQXlxMv1-iiCFuyYy-xo38AKFCl80nzlbtZDVUBDkZYCIM1X7mtQ_hiWsKtDg6I7_JGM96qHBEuFtXThZ_uWLwa7Hogt0PuIzHNa96wW3mtjeZHVb9Y3FlvOroI_60Mb-RgZuyVO9SrmP2Yi_K8Opo4fWT8WZPMUUt8UqVQUf4k111gwp8HcGSCCYuoPo4zqQDv-ElFH23FfoIqlUJ2bwwr2urJsZDvkyrAmqaKjyg%3D)

**In case you don 't know me, my name is Joe Males, and I'm a proud Mexican-American, U.S. Marine Veteran, small business owner, and a city councilman who's running for Congress in CA-25. But above all else, I'm a father who is still in mourning.**

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=ca10967e65334e0e859055ed4761a4c2&_e=iDoofNiSfBw6Yb9CtXQ2i6ATalEkIiZF95I8lwIZbqxl5DQZGzjjlkom9Mq9WE2mwJk3ixBgvk2veG4H2mETOxP9oC9Wvc4r8Lsbo6qKkmfHpzSo1uNReCJkQgJEC1IzjDntlVn3y5avZugkSv8IPbwAanhO9M4KbxYulv_61tIwqNEI5QV962OR486YUKJALP1LMVotA16h8SjnM47a0sNaDT8NBy6pYgMSoouxk_UTuLldxDu9em-6bXHoTJ8MMIE6wf7r6rxpTS1sA9c8AFpiVBnTtm7esxx1h8XKTFxIKyfJIjQZ7zoynzt97l_-AfOxGN3R8syVVhzUPuRWX37U7IskDunwYtUDE3LQjoUgXWp7XXgoSphDaUWDLiy-plCqFNUCU9H3zG-ewZPJXLJ_4XjIoSJe68NHLZvSODNqXTFqXCw_sl4eQZY2UaEWEycEOL0R89a2DNtT2v8J-j254a4lFRL6GMJzXw5yUnU-IV7tcrxnkAqSDxMjG-Dko7GeC__0Q5sqwEeOXoRZ28z6LRNDPl9VQPUQCB7_s2I%3D)
**I ran for city council and am running for Congress because of my son, Nicholas.**

In 2016, Nicholas came home to visit for his sister's birthday and Father's Day. It was supposed to be a wonderful time to bring our family back together. Then, he was tragically stabbed to death in my hometown of Hemet, California.

[](http://links.joemalesforca.com/u/click?_t=87a0bf2fd7e446429f4e355f2cd52f45&_m=ca10967e65334e0e859055ed4761a4c2&_e=iDoofNiSfBw6Yb9CtXQ2i6ATalEkIiZF95I8lwIZbqxl5DQZGzjjlkom9Mq9WE2mwJk3ixBgvk2veG4H2mETOxP9oC9Wvc4r8Lsbo6qKkmfHpzSo1uNReCJkQgJEC1IzjDntlVn3y5avZugkSv8IPbwAanhO9M4KbxYulv_61tIwqNEI5QV962OR486YUKJAszoMcPgDVYGw_PvPzXAW5M3TU6eaT9im-k5iuTBK0MQ2LxHBN8ZpR9_CBVrpG8OJMAZ1lt4SdVa__6qAsEDpL1C3nPE_hE_13kW-LGxLboNX8963LBXNJtYjuXc0JTLfFz_hkWNLvzE17OQOv4SmkDz6dANkpdxga-8UQflk4mankY4vFq6BINoMcCaY3ZWX8NrXND1k6-ICQMmoDLVRt55Rng_6mL0EzgwkiXxbxuwRUSBRASQpfoOSdLNRPMUYuJjl0L1OpJVr4Oziiq3GEDDE_G4CJ3q_1XyAANVNc9o3mT4w6qqmqF1OSgwys9Js2qniLrQIpAK1hfTKA6TyYbSIeMYnzkgr_7xhZQz_sd4%3D)
No one stepped forward with information on my son's killer, so the case went cold. After five years of not knowing anything about what happened, I decided to do something about it. I ran for City Council, and just a few months later, by the grace of God, they found the killer.

As a parent, losing your child is the most difficult thing to go through. But I'm pushing through it and am committed to making him proud as I fight for a better tomorrow for his children.

I'm grateful to Hemet's law enforcement, who was able to find the killer and arrest him.

Nicholas serves as a daily reminder to me to never take a single precious moment for granted and that I must continue to fight every single day for a better future.

subject: What’s happening in New Hampshire.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
Chris Pappas is in a tied race — and Republicans are coming for this seat.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260528_3.faIFtu&refcode=em20260528-3&t=1&akid=6884%2E582294%2EmXIcRX)
Hi, it’s Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.
There’s a lot of noise in an election year — I know that better than most. But let me be very clear: **The Senate race in New Hampshire could decide the direction of this country.**
Chris Pappas is running in a tied race. It could be a toss-up. And with Donald Trump in the White House, the stakes couldn’t be higher.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $5, or anything you can, right now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260528_3.faIFtu&refcode=em20260528-3&t=2&akid=6884%2E582294%2EmXIcRX)**
The first year of this second Trump Administration has seen chaos, division, and dangerous rollbacks of basic freedoms. That’s why it’s so important we elect leaders like Chris Pappas — leaders who know how to bring people together, deliver real results, and never forget who they’re fighting for.
Chris’s opponent is a former U.S. Senator with national name recognition and the backing of national Republicans and their deep-pocketed super PACs. Republicans believe they can flip this seat and block any chance we have of checking Trump’s power in Washington.
But I believe in Chris — and I believe we can win.
Chris understands that leadership isn’t about grabbing headlines or scoring political points. It’s about showing up, listening, and doing the hard work to deliver for working families. He’s done that in Congress, and I know he’ll bring that same spirit of public service to the Senate.
Kentucky and New Hampshire may look different, but our constituents are people who want the same things: good jobs, strong schools, access to health care, and a future we can build together. That’s what Chris Pappas is fighting for. **_But he can’t do it alone._**
**[If you’re with me — and ready to stop Trump and his allies from flipping this critical seat — chip in now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260528_3.faIFtu&refcode=em20260528-3&t=3&akid=6884%2E582294%2EmXIcRX)**

Thank you for standing up and stepping in when it counts.
Let’s get Chris across the finish line.
Thank you,
Andy Beshear
Governor of Kentucky

On Friday morning over 600 hundred Louisianans showed up to the Louisiana state capitol to protest and speak out against a new Congressional map proposed by the Louisiana GOP that will erase Louisiana's two black majority districts and establish all white districts.
During the hearing on redistricting, GOP State Senator Jay Morris yelled "Shut up, boy" to my Executive Director Dadrius Lanus, a Black man, who, in Sen. Morris’s words was “commenting and talking” too loudly for him to concentrate.
Sir, I am a 70 year old Black man and we know what it means to be called “Boy.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-louisianadems]
Senator Morris says we misheard. That the audio proves it. That he said “you all need to shut up” to the Black constituents behind him outraged that their votes won't be counted.
Senator Morris, an elected member of our legislature, thinks if he had yelled “you all need to shut up” it would be better.
It wouldn't.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that White people have been telling Black folk to “shut up" for over 250 years.
What Senator Morris doesn’t understand is that we remember being told we were 3/5ths of a person. That even when we won personhood in the eyes of the law, they instituted poll taxes and “reading” tests. That when we marched and dreamed and cried and buried loved ones who had hung as strange fruit from tall trees because they raised their voices too loud that what Black people have always wanted is equality.
Or maybe Senator Morris does understand all that.
I don’t know.
What I do know is that I am a 70 year old Black man. And I don’t let anyone call me or my brothers “Boy.”

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Your labs said "normal." You felt anything but.
body:
Plus: Comply with our illegal law — or we'll sue you. Only in NM | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/haON_ZN2WzD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
New Mexico Democrats passed an anti-ICE law — and now they're threatening to sue their own counties over the very law the DOJ is suing the state for. [We break down the hypocrisy.](https://us.list-manage.com/QkHzmSzyWBo?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Then we switch gears completely:** ER veteran [Jalayne Faulhaber](https://us.list-manage.com/flCjnRz2RJt?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) joins us to bust the HRT, GLP-1, and testosterone myths that keep people scared — starting with the 2002 study that misled a whole generation of women.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/bqee8wfi95L?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🏛️ **DEMS THREATEN COUNTIES OVER A LAW THE DOJ IS SUING THEM FOR**
House Bill 9 — the "Immigrant Safety Act" — bars New Mexico counties from cooperating with ICE. Otero County signed a five-year contract and told Santa Fe exactly where to put it.
Now Democratic leaders are warning those counties: fall in line, or get sued.
The problem? The federal government is already suing the state over the same law. And one Democratic senator said something in that hearing that quietly gives the whole game away.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/1D4ykb_scyD?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🔥 **"NORMAL" LABS — AND STILL FEELING TERRIBLE**
Krysty had done all the bloodwork. Every result came back "normal." She still wasn't sleeping, the weight wouldn't budge, and the joint pain wouldn't quit.
Jalayne explains the difference between "normal" and "optimal" — and why one number told a completely different story than Krysty's old doctor did.
**Then there's HRT. That single 2002 study scared a generation of women away from it. Jalayne breaks down what she says it got wrong — hear it before you make up your mind.
** ⚠️ **THE VIAL LABELED "RESEARCH ONLY"**
GLP-1s are everywhere now — and so is the temptation to buy them cheap online.
One of Jalayne's patients did exactly that. The first injection, she was fine. The second one, she passed out in her driveway and ended up in the ER.
What was actually in that vial — and why "too good to be true" almost always is.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/tRWaKv0lkBF?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |

PLUS: Mark reads the column from the Santa Fe writer who spent 2022 trashing him — wait until you hear what the critic finally admits. And for the guys: why "normal" testosterone might be exactly why you crash every afternoon at 3 p.m.

🩺 **WORK WITH JALAYNE**
Our guest is Jalayne Faulhaber, FNP, at Foundation Health & Wellness in Albuquerque.

**Web:** [foundationhw.com](https://us.list-manage.com/d5_1E3iG5gJ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Instagram:** [@foundationhealthwellness](https://us.list-manage.com/ZenDpBD0m5w?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
**Facebook:** [Foundationhw](https://us.list-manage.com/1BQ93qKbNnG?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---

## Paxton Faces Cash Challenge
Ken Paxton defeated four-term Sen. John Cornyn in the Texas Republican Senate primary runoff earlier this week, [winning the GOP nomination](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SpCAUhZ8GMyy4imhAsInZbLqhxc91mloEC-6M3fv0W_YrTHyqzvm-8-dj-7Axxfz52x5o6LmXLePVEhJh3axzhWiviP-w0VekWHL5xnpuIGDiQnFYtmBjem1jF4wTYZEdGqlnIRSoRXUPM4ZZ6XkUekBvAacwL1qDUtpq5b3ALpq7TChYpBSDlP0yWCd2AcFNMCxOslFgiFRqTw8kfNq2p9eN0ftydMk8iM7Ghl8MVgbrdV19dv62uHMG61lSpOgbg_WNjQn9bcJgrXh-uRS9zY0fJeOLn7W4hEfj7yH-FzM_7ZNK5lfMvPpsh1HLWXXVhPOKKcU2aTaKz8PG9Aain934beB_AAAA__-vn4jf) for a November contest against Democratic state Rep. James Talarico, a contest that has national Republicans bracing for a costly fight. Paxton had raised $7.6 million with $2.3 million cash on hand, while Talarico pulled in [more than $40 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2OpDoQhZ8GMrfsMgY7ILgJ2dx0Q-Sf8rS1BiO7GLr36VeMNth8s0-qUtX5dH58rB825bR__m83nOkVy7rj1TISYV2tc4UoVsRf2OhMlMpevrAeK3AYGVcMzBpsyu916MPseDCix1lMmnMFyqj-OQuMEfQkkANIPYpBiDhpgc44H7iCPs33Ma7ACMGlEA8jreORQ3AjSONEN3AMiUp90BMJX7bF_L5jPHzZ-jw_iY7Wyf86WDpYrut6_MS9qXvawWIrJZ-xg-UW62A5Sk6U_I2Y0d9OfzOr2M5MjX1_YkdNm61vVs-9xNhYw90SMocvW5kv505vFuyf5Wc5G7KKx-ly8nZnAbfiq6UOFpgki1o5GNXIlBkNG9CMTMtJslEE6bXWFiX0dQ7HlXJObZy6gX9uNuVvU_q3fr5m-B0AAP__-ISl-g) during the primary cycle. Talarico's campaign reported raising an additional $600,000 in the two hours after the runoff. A GOP consultant warned the party may need to spend up to $100 million to hold the seat, potentially pulling resources from other battleground states as Republicans defend their Senate majority. Texas' roughly 20 media markets make statewide advertising among the most expensive in the country. Cornyn pledged in his concession speech to support Paxton in the [general election](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUD2P3CAQ_TW4YwXjtX0UFGncXdqU1mDGZyQMFsze7ubXR1hK_kC60XtP8z5-fS6fGGJIXz_xIMuvLS-JnjUSM5UFncvMWyH6TZUfgUNO-ZvKuYCCUapBglk8hvhe7p23TnmjO7J6-lBqgMEM3W7JT2YzOI4favDKAKE3aHD1I3jo9b0Ltj1TAxitVa_1zfTo1KbAuxF647S4K_KBc7nxTkwvrFt8txi3NR9dtDvzWUX_Q8AsYF7zcTxS4Hc4Tly5aQTM-KgcUqMpccEo_wEUaW29BMwth4BZDe2eBMyXmayMTM_gSf7VVomFZCWWWy6yTXI4KnKnQhfDO8kVkw8emarM6UIcxpi5K9afzxBjqOMk7urrwBCvJvx_-39b-BMAAP__x5mdlw) against Talarico, saying he trusts Texas voters.
## Abbott Freezes Texas Tuition Again
Gov. Greg Abbott [issued a directive](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHSnCAUBeCnwQ4HLiJSUKSx-9OmdBAuyoTVHby77ubpM27yBn99Zs6c7_z6mr58LnlbfvobOnqlfdrwPAoSYZ38PO9EqSL-wYMemfK-7U-s9wkE9FxoDnaKPpf31DXRzSJa2aCTZhBCg7a6WV2ySoE0KoUuYESlbbBRhGT0IIUGaLK7yoQGK6VQUrZW-VkkAXHuQdlZsk5gzLTXllYkfPkjlfc1ow37rSluJbofTP1gMDIYz_Nsfz8feIUMRl8ph4IMxsvFYMT4CP6CMBg_ZTzspeCC_D-Q5y1U9AcefPWF-FJx4f-e4B82CDAMRugt7wYjlfDITUqWd4CaD71Gjmh8kFJ2Vqumung_cyn56A3rxHLzuXym0_cOfzr4GwAA__8fXpKo) this week ordering all Texas public colleges and universities to freeze undergraduate tuition and fees through the 2026-2027 academic year. It's the fourth consecutive year Abbott has maintained the [tuition freeze](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFy5CAMhp8Gd-yAdvHiguIad7n2Sg8Y2daENTsgr5N7-htyeYN0Go306_v0521685RoX3_7Bzr-WPK041kTMmOZfAiZeSmIf7HyQUx5zy8szwkU9FIZCcMUPaXP6dZFF1QcdIdO361SBsxgus1ZY4Kdb0F5gN5bPWi9WNvbaIMGAN-Ra2HKwKC1ump9Ga4-qEVBDD1ch6DFTWEkzuXCGzJ--Lqkz4ZxmfOjS25jflZx_SVgFDCe53mZE83vsOWjct7blICxaQkYU559EjC2mwJGZVp9FzCu-SXXgqv8Ly2_reW3ttzoHav0LJ9HSDTLOaeEa2vtUR47vbBUYmobW8nHuklQX8FdcfF5UkpU-7u4qfXhKX2h888e_nLwLwAA__-rX5Xx), a policy first introduced in 2023. ## Fertitta to Acquire Caesars Entertainment
Houston billionaire Tilman Fertitta struck [a deal to acquire Caesars Entertainment](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u4yAURleDOyy4GDsUFNO4e9NOafFzeUaDTYRv4mRWP3K28OojfTrf-fO1fLlc8v79221o6ZXqsuN5FCTCtjjvK1FqiP_woEemXPf6xHZfQMDIheZgluhyeS9DF60X0cgOrZxuQmjQRnerFcYHGVGFaQpaYYzeQ5QaNQxpFEp32V5jQoORUigpe6OcF0lA9CMo4yUbBMZMtfW0IuHLHam8L40-1K0rdiW6H0z9YjAzmM_z7P-u9XFBBrNrlENBBvP1i8FcanCFwUy5bG7nCRtlIseDw8O1g0f8YLhpjgaSTj5wJ8fEBwOKm2mQXIpBjErd9DhB12y8n7mUfIwTG8T35nL5iNHPcj4t_A8AAP__eVGHMg) in a transaction valued at $17.6 billion, capping a years-long pursuit of the casino giant. The all-cash equity portion of the transaction totals approximately $5.7 billion--a 49% premium over Caesars' unaffected share price as of Feb. 25, 2026. Fertitta's company would absorb roughly 52 Caesars casinos across the U.S., adding to his existing Golden Nugget casino portfolio and Landry's restaurant empire. The agreement includes a "go-shop" period through July 11, 2026, during which [Caesars can solicit competing bids](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uxCAQhJ_G7jgtYDAUFGmuu7QprcVe-5Dwj2BzP3n6yHmFlKORRt98X7fhhimnbfnElQK_5n3Y6FkzMVMZMMadeS5EP1T5O3Hat_1B5RgUKCvACOWHCVN-D107hQiTly0F2TsAo4w37T30kYzV1BkNrrcWXJwtqo7AS3CjMW0K5xgY5aUELeXFa4wwg5qiVdpH2XRAU-K9XPhOTC-sc36fGJdxX9sc7sxHbfRHo66NuuJxHjirMxROY6ZGXUekiqWKjFU8aMEqCm27oI2pMKZtpY3Fgms8ZYiZCidmFMZqFcE5bYzXDgz2rsdplMZaJKd1W8J0PFPOqdq-6WBZMeU_Lv6fzUdQvwEAAP__JmuIrw). Fertitta first approached the company about a merger back in 2018, making Thursday's announcement the culmination of an eight-year chase. The Galveston-born mogul--who also owns the Houston Rockets--would become one of the largest gaming operators in the country if the deal clears regulatory and shareholder approval. Caesars shareholders must still vote on the transaction.

| I've been telling my readers for a while now that the SpaceX story was getting closer.
[**Now I believe we're entering the part that matters most.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTF9AAwAAAAAAOcFa-eUlazMNSoXP8YXxyN7xWXwj_0HM50FK9SO_FnmbW0yFe9s0omL5Z9ll0XclWxr56Q5DIsIoTLQ2uwSRBxuQ2u8_-5w1hfQb_wHRQ)
Because once Wall Street fully locks in its position, regular investors tend to hear about it last.
That's why I don't want you waiting until **June 12** to start paying attention.
By then, the crowd may finally catch up.
And when that happens, the easiest money is usually gone.

name: James Carville, Senior Democratic Strategist
subject: My honest assessment of New Hampshire:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The math to flip the Senate runs through New Hampshire. Here’s why that should concern you.
Hi. It's James Carville.
I’ve been watching Senate races for decades. What I’m seeing in New Hampshire right now is keeping me up at night — and it should concern y’all too.
I put together a brief memo. Read it. Then let’s help Chris Pappas win this race.
**[If you don’t need convincing, rush a donation to Chris Pappas’s campaign now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260529_1.qRmfHZ&refcode=em20260529-1&t=1&akid=6885%2E582294%2E0B-zEk)**
**[Donate »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260529_1.qRmfHZ&refcode=em20260529-1&t=2&akid=6885%2E582294%2E0B-zEk)**
* * *
**SPRING 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON NH-SEN**
**FROM:** James Carville, Senior Democratic Strategist
**TO:** Interested Parties
I need to be clear with you about where things stand in the race for New Hampshire’s open Senate seat.
**The New Hampshire Senate race has been in the margin of error for months — and it’s not getting the attention it deserves.**
* Three recent polls show this race in a dead heat:
* Emerson (March 2026): Pappas 45–Sununu 44
* St. Anselm (March 2026): Pappas 46–Sununu 43
* St. Anselm (November 2025): Pappas 44–Sununu 41
* All of these polls show this race **within the margin of error. The race has been functionally tied for months.**
* New Hampshire’s open Senate seat is sitting in a dead heat with significantly less financial firepower on our side than we have in other Senate races.
* This race will almost certainly be decided by whether Chris Pappas has the resources to compete on the airwaves and on the ground in the final stretch.

**The GOP knows exactly what’s at stake here — and they’re already moving.**
* The Senate Leadership Fund has committed over $17 million to elect John Sununu — their largest investment in New Hampshire in a decade.
* John Sununu is not a back-bench candidate. He has a famous New Hampshire political name (his father and his brother both served as governor), a history of winning statewide, and the full weight of the Republican donor machine behind him.
* And here’s something voters in New Hampshire deserve to know: Sununu left the Senate in 2009 and spent the years following building a personal fortune — with assets estimated as high as $36 million — through corporate board positions and investments in oil and gas companies, including ExxonMobil, Shell, and more. He left New Hampshire, cashed in, and now wants to come back.
* Republicans understand the math perfectly. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire’s Senate seat and make Democrats’ path to a majority impossible.

**New Hampshire has decided elections before — and the margins are razor thin.**
* In 2016, the last time New Hampshire had a race for an open Senate seat, the race was decided by just 1,017 votes.
* When Democrats chart a path to retaking the Senate majority, New Hampshire is not optional. If Chris Pappas loses, Democrats need to flip five seats instead of four. That math does not exist.

**There is a recent and painful precedent for underestimating a close race.**
* Bob Casey narrowly led in Pennsylvania polling for virtually the entire 2024 cycle — and lost in an upset that shocked the entire party.
* A race that has been tied for six months is not a comfortable position. It is a warning sign. I have seen what happens when we assume a race is in-hand and the resources don’t follow.
* We cannot afford to let New Hampshire’s 2026 race echo Pennsylvania’s in 2024.

**Chris Pappas has what it takes to win — but the outside spending gap is real.**
* Pappas has won New Hampshire’s toughest congressional district four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle. His campaign has outraised Sununu candidate-to-candidate with $4.2 million cash on hand to Sununu’s $1.9 million.
* But that advantage disappears the moment the Senate Leadership Fund’s $17 million hits the airwaves. In a race decided by a handful of votes, being drowned out on TV by Republican money in the final weeks is the ballgame.
* This is the moment to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the race you wish you’d paid more attention to.

* * *
Listen: I don’t write memos like this for every race. I wrote this one because I’m genuinely worried about what happens if New Hampshire slips away while everyone’s looking somewhere else.
The numbers are clear. The stakes are real. Now I need you to act.
**[Rush a donation to Chris Pappas right now. Don’t let New Hampshire be the race we wish we’d paid more attention to.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260529_1.qRmfHZ&refcode=em20260529-1&t=3&akid=6885%2E582294%2E0B-zEk)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260529_1.qRmfHZ&amount=5&refcode=em20260529-1&t=4&akid=6885%2E582294%2E0B-zEk)**
Thank you for your support. Let’s elect Chris Pappas and flip the Senate.
– James Carville

**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

A personal campaign update from me
# [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1100?t=1&akid=594%2E3892029%2EUAYKhV)

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/av-em-q22026?refcode=em260529-1&refcode2=594_3892029_UAYKhV&akid=594%2E3892029%2EUAYKhV)
**_Defying the odds._**
**May 29: A campaign update from Alex Vindman for Peter.**
Please don’t scroll away. Today is Friday, May 29th, and I am humbly asking you to make your first online contribution to my Senate campaign before our May fundraising deadline passes.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – the next child is already missing.

For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.
| | | | | |
---
[ ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkM2K3DAQhJ9Gvtnoxz87Bx0Cg2-bQwjkaHqkliVWlkyrnWXePkxIHmCvVUVR9f16394h5VT273CgJQ4bta1F_ITGBCEk94E-VBonD8-2aannXk69vr1yqvPWOw_KdWjV8iblNMtx6qKV4-3NgwmLmTWEx_xQY_ATKjS4KIOuS_ZVJSd9U1rKcRz0YhYj1SKNekwTejFKyEg8EJ7XIycHhaF9hEoOB1ePLtvIfDZhvgm9Cr36WoBx4IgRqWILleJ1QEn8HCrtQq8FONUCuWeCVFLZe4eFkfoMV3Gxb7ESb2d_1lOYldBdRKnswtyZLhR6vvjY2Alz__Fz1f3_A_8MVwtjYWHueEDKqiPrz8-Uc2rzIka5v9S_y_nrnH9b_ScAAP__tN-N4g)
---
Friend,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**
---
[ ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkM2K3DAQhJ9Gvtnoxz87Bx0Cg2-bQwjkaHqkliVWlkyrnWXePkxIHmCvVUVR9f16394h5VT273CgJQ4bta1F_ITGBCEk94E-VBonD8-2aannXk69vr1yqvPWOw_KdWjV8iblNMtx6qKV4-3NgwmLmTWEx_xQY_ATKjS4KIOuS_ZVJSd9U1rKcRz0YhYj1SKNekwTejFKyEg8EJ7XIycHhaF9hEoOB1ePLtvIfDZhvgm9Cr36WoBx4IgRqWILleJ1QEn8HCrtQq8FONUCuWeCVFLZe4eFkfoMV3Gxb7ESb2d_1lOYldBdRKnswtyZLhR6vvjY2Alz__Fz1f3_A_8MVwtjYWHueEDKqiPrz8-Uc2rzIka5v9S_y_nrnH9b_ScAAP__tN-N4g)
---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkM2K3DAQhJ9Gvtnoxz87Bx0Cg2-bQwjkaHqkliVWlkyrnWXePkxIHmCvVUVR9f16394h5VT273CgJQ4bta1F_ITGBCEk94E-VBonD8-2aannXk69vr1yqvPWOw_KdWjV8iblNMtx6qKV4-3NgwmLmTWEx_xQY_ATKjS4KIOuS_ZVJSd9U1rKcRz0YhYj1SKNekwTejFKyEg8EJ7XIycHhaF9hEoOB1ePLtvIfDZhvgm9Cr36WoBx4IgRqWILleJ1QEn8HCrtQq8FONUCuWeCVFLZe4eFkfoMV3Gxb7ESb2d_1lOYldBdRKnswtyZLhR6vvjY2Alz__Fz1f3_A_8MVwtjYWHueEDKqiPrz8-Uc2rzIka5v9S_y_nrnH9b_ScAAP__tN-N4g)
---
| [MAKE A GIFT TODAY](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkM2K3DAQhJ9Gvtnoxz87Bx0Cg2-bQwjkaHqkliVWlkyrnWXePkxIHmCvVUVR9f16394h5VT273CgJQ4bta1F_ITGBCEk94E-VBonD8-2aannXk69vr1yqvPWOw_KdWjV8iblNMtx6qKV4-3NgwmLmTWEx_xQY_ATKjS4KIOuS_ZVJSd9U1rKcRz0YhYj1SKNekwTejFKyEg8EJ7XIycHhaF9hEoOB1ePLtvIfDZhvgm9Cr36WoBx4IgRqWILleJ1QEn8HCrtQq8FONUCuWeCVFLZe4eFkfoMV3Gxb7ESb2d_1lOYldBdRKnswtyZLhR6vvjY2Alz__Fz1f3_A_8MVwtjYWHueEDKqiPrz8-Uc2rzIka5v9S_y_nrnH9b_ScAAP__tN-N4g "MAKE A GIFT TODAY")
---
**Additionally, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – _to free the oppressed, so others may live._
Respectfully submitted,
Dennis Price
Founder & CEO
Heroes for Humanity

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. May is almost over, which means so is Mental Health Awareness Month.
I'm sure you've seen familiar slogans fill your feed like:
"You are not alone."
"It's okay to not be okay."
"Mental health is physical health."
All of these are true. But here's what you don't typically hear:
**[Every day, 135 Americans die by suicide](https://substack.com/redirect/57d22a06-2d4f-41f9-b2ed-24d9a4139a7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

**It's the equivalent of a commercial plane crash every single day. Or **[one death every 11 minutes.](https://substack.com/redirect/809f55d4-7100-413f-88e3-28f73aa1df98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
And still, we look away.
Among post-9/11 veterans, the crisis is even worse and often ignored.
Since 9/11,[ more than 120,000 veterans have died by suicide](https://substack.com/redirect/e48c2f4d-71e0-47cc-99bf-78f778a3b245?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- more than 17 times the number killed in combat in Iraq, Afghanistan or Iran.
That's why I co-chair [Face the Fight](https://substack.com/redirect/51ff3ee1-6db7-4e4c-b964-64f9f3db84f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--an $80+ million national private-sector effort to end this epidemic funding evidence-based solutions across the country.
In January, a veteran named Luke High reached out to me. He's given me permission to share his story.
Luke was a junior in high school when he watched the Twin Towers fall. It motivated him to enroll in ROTC while competing as a Division I pole vaulter at Ohio University; he was part of the first class to graduate knowing they were heading straight into the war on terror.
He spent nearly two decades in uniform, rising to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel, teaching marketing strategy at West Point, and serving with the 82nd Airborne -- the same unit I served in -- across deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan. Today, he faces a battle no military training could prepare him for.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd628a6d-560c-498f-be2c-97dbfae99035?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 2020, while deployed in Afghanistan, Luke began coughing up blood.
For the next four years, he became a medical mystery, bouncing between the NIH, Walter Reed, Johns Hopkins, the Cleveland Clinic, and National Jewish Health in Colorado. Specialists studied scans of his lungs searching for answers.
On New Year's Eve 2024, Luke finally got one.
He was diagnosed with an extraordinarily rare condition called [dendriform pulmonary ossification](https://substack.com/redirect/843cb6db-24e0-4e9a-9d2b-d127a9b4ef7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). His lungs are calcifying, slowly turning into bone.
That same night, Luke attempted suicide. Thankfully, he's still here to tell his story.
Every time Luke's lungs are damaged, they heal with calcium and ossified bone matter instead of normal tissue. It is essentially a slow form of pulmonary fibrosis, except instead of scar tissue, his lungs are becoming skeletal.
There are only around 30 documented cases in medical literature. Luke is one of just four known veterans diagnosed with it.
Doctors removed half his left lung trying to understand what was happening inside it. But after surgery, he suffered a stroke. Then came infections and more surgeries. Complications spread throughout the rest of his body.
He says some days he struggles to form complete sentences because the anxiety, depression, migraines, and neurological strain become overwhelming.
On top of all this, it has been an ordeal for him to access care.
After retiring from the Army in August, Luke didn't receive his VA disability rating until the fall. Once he finally received it, he called to schedule appointments through the VA. The earliest available appointment was four months away.
Due to the severity of his condition, Luke retired from his 18-year career in the military. He is now rated 100 percent permanently and totally disabled by the VA. Yet under current law, combat-wounded veterans who retire early face what advocates call a "wounded veteran tax" -- their retirement pay is offset dollar for dollar by their VA disability compensation. Had Luke served an extra two years, he would have avoided this penalty entirely. That's why he's been advocating for the[ Major Richard Star Act](https://substack.com/redirect/bc6f54c2-1c9a-4c96-9ab4-29fb9159371f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- bipartisan legislation that would allow combat-wounded veterans medically retired before reaching 20 years of service to receive both concurrently, something many veterans believed they had already earned through years of service and sacrifice.
As Luke put it to me, "We shouldn't have to fight this hard for what we've earned."
He is doing his best to build a civilian life while navigating a degenerative disease with no cure, no treatment roadmap, and almost no long-term research behind it.
If you know a veteran who is struggling, check on them.
And if you're a veteran reading this who is struggling right now -- know you have a community of support. There is no shame in asking for help.
If you're a patriot who wants to be part of the solution, share this and join our [Face the Fight](https://substack.com/redirect/51ff3ee1-6db7-4e4c-b964-64f9f3db84f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) movement. Do it for fellow patriots like Luke who've earned our support.
**Veterans Crisis Line (24/7)** You do not need to be enrolled in VA benefits to call.
Dial 988, then press 1
Text 838255
VeteransCrisisLine.net
**National Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (24/7)**
Dial 988
988lifeline.org

### Casselberry Canvass with Team Kinter!

The only way we win this race is by talking directly to our neighbors. We are united by the belief that we deserve better and we can have it. That change starts with us - mobilizing together and reaching our neighbors directly to build the community we all deserve.
Join Marialana and the team this Saturday & Sunday as we hit the pavement in Casselberry to discuss our mission to stop the squeeze on working families, protect our environment, and bring real accountability to Washington. Whether you are a seasoned canvasser or this is your first time, we have a spot for you! We will provide training, scripts, and walk lists. Bring comfortable shoes, a water bottle, and your Kinter for Congress gear! Mission Details:
* Meetup Time: 9:45 AM (For training and materials)
* Canvassing Hours: 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM
* Location: Sally's Diner: 899 FL-436, Casselberry, FL 32707, USA

### Weekly Volunteer Virtual Meetings

Be part of the movement to bring bold, people-first leadership to Florida's 7th Congressional District. Team Kinter is organizing across the district to fight for affordable housing, economic justice, accessible healthcare, and a government that works for everyday people, not wealthy special interests. Join us for our weekly volunteer meeting on Wednesday, June 3rd at 7:00 PM to learn how you can make a direct impact on this grassroots campaign. Whether you're interested in knocking doors, making calls, helping with social media, planning events, or supporting behind the scenes, there's a place for you on the team. We've also launched new volunteer committees to help supporters get involved in the areas they care most about. Opportunities include Press and Media, Data and Precinct Organizing, Administrative and Research Support, Events, and Community Tabling. By signing up, you'll be able to share your interests, skills, and availability so we can connect you with the best volunteer opportunities. Supporters can also request a campaign shirt and stay updated on future organizing efforts across the district.
* Wednesday, June 3rd at 7:00 PM
* Together, we can build a stronger, more people-powered future for District 7. If you have any questions, please reach out to [lee@kinterforcongress.com](mailto:lee@kinterforcongress.com).

Peter, From June 11–13, _thousands_ of grassroots Texans from across the state will gather in Houston for the Republican Party of Texas State Convention, _and TFVC is planning on making a big splash!_ **RPT Convention is where delegates adopt the Party Platform, establish Legislative Priorities, and elect party leadership. ** These decisions play a direct role in the fight for medical liberty, as they directly influence the policy battles we will face in 2027 at the Texas Capitol. For TFVC, this convention is especially important because **the Republican Party of Texas is currently the only statewide political party to explicitly recognize the principles of vaccine choice** , and this convention gives grassroots Texans the opportunity to strengthen and expand informed consent protections. **All of these are on the table in June.**

That's why we'll be actively working to support key medical liberty priorities at convention, including:
* ******Ending Vaccine Mandates for Healthcare Workers**
* **Ending Vaccine Mandates for Healthcare Students**
* **Prohibiting Patient Dismissal Based on Vaccine Status**

If you’ll be attending convention, I hope you’ll make plans to stop by the **TFVC Booth (#627)** to meet our team, learn more about the legislative priorities we’re fighting for, and connect with fellow advocates for medical liberty from across the state. [And if you are unable to attend in person, you can still help fuel this important work!](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTg4ODA2Mjc1NTA5NzgxOTQ0LFwiclwiOjE4ODgwNjM5NjIzMjMzNjgyMn0iLCJzIjoiY2YyMTljNWFmNTA5MDA1YiJ9) From RPT handouts to delegate outreach and advocacy efforts, TFVC’s presence at convention is only possible because of faithful supporters who believe medical liberty must remain a priority in Texas.****

| | | [ **Push for Medical Liberty at Convention** ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTg4ODA2Mjc1NTI1NTEwNTkzLFwiclwiOjE4ODgwNjM5NjIzMjMzNjgyMn0iLCJzIjoiM2E0NjE3Njc2ZjI1OWNlNiJ9)

Rebecca Hardy

RPT Convention is where delegates adopt the Party Platform, establish Legislative Priorities, and elect party leadership. These decisions play a direct role in the fight for medical liberty, as they directly influence the policy battles we will face in 2027 at the Texas Capitol. For TFVC, this convention is especially important because the Republican Party of Texas is currently the only statewide political party to explicitly recognize the principles of vaccine choice , and this convention gives grassroots Texans the opportunity to strengthen and expand informed consent protections. All of these are on the table in June. That's why we'll be actively working to support key medical liberty priorities at convention, including: **Ending Vaccine Mandates for Healthcare Workers Ending Vaccine Mandates for Healthcare Students Prohibiting Patient Dismissal Based on Vaccine Status If you’ll be attending convention, I hope you’ll make plans to stop by the TFVC Booth (#627) to meet our team, learn more about the legislative priorities we’re fighting for, and connect with fellow advocates for medical liberty from across the state. name: Kimberly Bretches
subject: In just days, my husband’s fate will be decided
body:
| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e917871/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvQkZ2YVAyeU1Teg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA1Mjk/LbmNsbnpCU0tyYQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNiZ0JTYUxyUzVLMFdscw/gahmTbA/sfk5960f37a)
| | | Dear Friend, I never imagined I would one day be begging strangers to help save my innocent husband from prison. But that’s exactly what I’m doing today. My husband, Austin Police Officer Chance Bretches, goes on trial beginning June 1st. And if radical anti-police prosecutors get their way, he could spend the rest of his life behind bars. **[That’s why I’m asking for your help today—as soon as possible.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Please let me explain. Chance is not a criminal. He’s a decorated police officer. A loving father. A Christian man who has dedicated his life to serving others. He received the Lifesaving Medal With Valor after rescuing a driver from a burning vehicle. He volunteers at church. He loves our children with his whole heart. But during the violent George Floyd riots in Austin, Chance was ordered to help restore order as mobs attacked police officers and tore through the city. Following his training, Chance used a non-lethal beanbag launcher to help disperse violent rioters. Now prosecutors are trying to destroy his life for it. My husband is charged with aggravated assault by a public servant — a charge that could send him to prison for life. Yes, life in prison...for doing his job. As his wife, I live every single day with the fear that our children could lose their father forever. And now that the trial begins June 1st, I’m doing my best to not let that fear become overwhelming. Because this is our last chance to fight back. **[That’s why I’m urgently asking patriotic Americans who still support law enforcement to stand with my husband today through the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** LELDF is helping fund Chance’s defense team, expert witnesses, investigators, and every part of the legal battle ahead. But trials are incredibly expensive. And with the trial only days away, I’m making one final plea for help before Chance walks into that courtroom. **[Will you please make an emergency tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more today to help fully fund Chance’s defense?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** I truly believe every gift matters right now, because your gift could be the difference in this trial. I know there are people in this country who hate police officers no matter what they do. But I also know there are still millions of Americans who believe cops should not be sacrificed to political witch hunts. I pray you’re one of them. Thank you for reading my message. And thank you for standing with my husband during the hardest battle of his life.
---
---
With hope and thanks,
---
Kimberly Bretches
---
P.S. My husband Chance goes on trial June 1st for his actions during the Austin riots. Prosecutors want to make an example out of him — even though he followed his training and used non-lethal force to stop violent chaos. **[As his wife, I’m begging patriotic Americans to help LELDF fully fund his defense before the trial begins. Please give whatever you can today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
|
---
_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit leldf.org. And remember –Blue Lives Matter!_ © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | [www.PoliceDefense.org](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Justice Samuel Alito's son has been secretly working as an attorney inside the Treasury Department.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rNXuq8Yj-ofQOsYeLUtNjBC95vNwrLlTTMqALK1eFFlz-sjHIIEWkiDz1YSS-glNIwTpIG7e1HwDiftgJDYHmgtx4M10VMMVJj8eT-Pdwx72TgtKehwHL0pfvyM3YUxdhIGt1TPrmIyKNtohetZToWGil-iQ1mWwmaq2ILme1q9pKtN9TGKMcFhfAjvHI61M5nwUT7OeIC0ZX4NDEpnrtMsb0Nl-I1fO&c=dELj0yOp0XKyizQ3YxH--u4PssDtKGmIn9PD89exVvyyIKtEL4cILw==&ch=AJSe9U4OS2q8SQFWDXxdOrrB1Q-ElPBQHwx7zEuSmN-Yl4v1odbSOA==)

|
Peter,
Something broke yesterday that connects every alarm we have raised about this Supreme Court into a single, damning picture.
Justice Samuel Alito's son has been secretly working as an attorney inside the Treasury Department since the early months of Trump's second term, briefed on the most sensitive legal matters across the entire department, offering counsel at the highest level on Treasury policy and law.
Alito's son was working inside the Treasury Department while a lawsuit challenging Trump's emergency powers landed before the court with the Treasury named as a defendant. He maintained no public profile, avoided giving his last name, and the Treasury never disclosed his employment in court filings. His father did not recuse himself.
The Treasury Department is now administering Trump's $1.8 billion "Anti-Weaponization Fund," taxpayer money with no congressional approval and no independent oversight, currently paying out to the January 6th insurrectionists Trump pardoned. Alito's son sits in the office providing legal oversight for that fund. When challenges reach the Supreme Court, they land in front of a bench that includes his father.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rNXuq8Yj-ofQOsYeLUtNjBC95vNwrLlTTMqALK1eFFlz-sjHIIEWkiDz1YSS-glNIwTpIG7e1HwDiftgJDYHmgtx4M10VMMVJj8eT-Pdwx72TgtKehwHL0pfvyM3YUxdhIGt1TPrmIyKNtohetZToWGil-iQ1mWwmaq2ILme1q9pKtN9TGKMcFhfAjvHI61M5nwUT7OeIC0ZX4NDEpnrtPkAaZfdkeVz&c=dELj0yOp0XKyizQ3YxH--u4PssDtKGmIn9PD89exVvyyIKtEL4cILw==&ch=AJSe9U4OS2q8SQFWDXxdOrrB1Q-ElPBQHwx7zEuSmN-Yl4v1odbSOA==)
---
This court is not just extreme. It is corrupt.
Clarence Thomas accepted years of luxury travel, private jet flights, and undisclosed vacation accommodations from a Texas billionaire with interests before the court. He never disclosed it or recused himself. When Congress demanded answers, the court stonewalled.
Samuel Alito accepted a private jet flight to an Alaskan fishing lodge from a conservative mega-donor. He flew a flag associated with the January 6th election denial movement outside his home. He declined to recuse himself from cases where conflicts were obvious. No accountability or consequences.
This is the court Leonard Leo built with $1.6 billion in dark money. The court that granted Trump criminal immunity. The court that gutted the Voting Rights Act. The court that opened the floodgates for the unlimited dark money that paid for all of it.
The only answer to a system this corrupt is to reform the institution at the top of it. That is what Unpack Our Courts is building, the movement to expand the court, establish term limits, and create the binding ethics code that would have made every abuse described above impossible.
That is the long game. The short game is to continue building a firewall of state Supreme Courts. We already built it in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin, and this November we are taking it to Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, and Minnesota, holding the line at the state level while we push federal reform through.

**$1.**
That’s how much we are asking you to donate to GIFFORDS before our May fundraising deadline ends this weekend.
Yes, really. Just $1.
We know what you’re thinking...“What difference can $1 really have?”
$1 might not mean a lot on its own — but by the time you read this, a dozen people have already chipped in $1. They know the power of this grassroots team, and they’re hoping you join them to help us stop gun violence.
Suddenly, your $1 gift adds up to $10,000 or even $25,000 of impact. We then have the resources to speak out against the USPS’s potential changes to allow handguns through the mail, run more ads, or reach voters in the most competitive of races.
_And look, persuading even a few hundred more voters to go to the polls could mean the difference between winning and losing._
If even half of the people reading this email donated $1, we would reach our ambitious fundraising goal and have the resources to overcome the gun lobby’s spending. But not everyone can, which is why we’re asking you:

Friend,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**

---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkEFvhCAUhH8N3jAIqPXAoenGpIftsT0aFh5CqmDg6Wb_feOm_QG9vXx5M5mZr-t01WEJcf7QKyhzhCmXqXi464JZOxfMN1iXsmytfpSJM95R1lI-nH9NZZWxneAVqKZ_YazjQjaVVzcNuhW86XsxMOnszTHW3SRjfS86M7gqqNOJtXxohGzFUDPOjDQDNGywxvUtkWzfrEYotUmxQD40hgNCjOm8UqxNWqtFecStEPFK-Ej4aFPUCDV68JATFJey31cdAz7qlGfCx_gU64Vi1iGGOFMDESHTRe_ReFp8yjhtdEsbEWMGs-cc4kzEBfMOhHc7rhMaIi5vn-_0r8QvNykiRCTiAqsOS1NlZbd7WJZQup5INp_0GRz_P_Wh-E8AAAD__1K2jzI)

**Additionally, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – _to free the oppressed, so others may live._

name: Cooper, Roy (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: Running for Senate wasn't part of the plan
body:
Seeing all of the chaos coming out of Washington DC, I knew I had to do something.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1552%2E124072%2Evt0bvK)
| | | |
---
Peter,

At the end of this message, **[I’m going to ask you to make your first donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11952?t=8&akid=1552%2E124072%2Evt0bvK)** But first, will you let me explain why your support – especially ahead of our end-of-month deadline – is so important?
Frankly, running for Senate wasn't part of the plan. I wanted to serve North Carolina from right here at home.

Seeing all of the chaos coming out of Washington DC, I knew I had to do something. Folks had placed their trust in me throughout my career as a public servant to fight for them – and **I felt that responsibility deeply.**
This is a race I simply could not walk away from. It’s also one I know we can win.

Since launching our campaign, tens of thousands of people have joined our grassroots movement. I’m so grateful to count you as one of them, Peter.
**With a recent poll showing this race statistically tied, and far-right Republicans spending millions to defeat me, I need your help to keep up our momentum.**
**[I set a goal to raise $500,000 before our May end-of-month deadline, and I’m counting on your support to reach it. Your contribution of $5 will be put to work immediately to help us win in North Carolina and take back the Senate. Will you chip in?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11953?amount=5&t=9&akid=1552%2E124072%2Evt0bvK)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11954?amount=5&t=10&akid=1552%2E124072%2Evt0bvK)

---
Despite all of the hate and division in our country right now, I will always believe in the basic goodness of people – and I will always have hope. Thanks for being by my side.

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

It’s
Jocelyn.

I know you’re hearing from a ton of campaigns right now asking for money.
And I know it seems like the requests are never-ending, so I wanted to
reach out and let you know exactly what your donation goes towards and why
your donation is so important.

campaign offices across Michigan.

outside groups will dump even more money in as this race heats up.

# **Florida Highway Patrol nets 249 illegal immigrants in three-day Operation 9 sweep across state**
Florida law police conducted Operation 9, a coordinated three-day operation where Florida Highway Patrol partnered with ICE, U.S. Border Patrol, Broward Sheriff's Office and other agencies to **[apprehend 249 undocumented immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/c3bd059b-6678-43f8-8249-739d27c53ecf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** along state roadways and transfer them to federal custody.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3bd059b-6678-43f8-8249-739d27c53ecf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The "ghosts":** Since March 2025, FHP troopers have encountered over 10,476 illegal immigrants during routine traffic stops, with Lt. Ramin Sulaiman noting many lack driver's licenses. Sulaiman warned of millions of unaccounted "ghosts," undocumented immigrants with no law enforcement records, residing in Florida.

* **Officers prioritize traffic violations as gateway to immigration enforcement** : Trooper Tony Golden said routine traffic infractions like speeding provide legal basis for stops that uncover undocumented status, rejecting accusations troopers target based on appearance while emphasizing "we are enforcing the law. We don't pick and choose what we want to enforce."

* **Detainees offered choices including assisted repatriation** : ICE public affairs officer Nestor Yglesias explained apprehended immigrants could arrange flights home or await immigration hearings, with government covering repatriation costs up to $2,600 depending on individual circumstances.

* * *
# **Ex-CIA officer David Rush arrested with $40M in gold bars, raising questions about vetting process failures**
Former CIA senior executive David Rush faces theft charges after the FBI raided his Virginia home May 18, **[discovering 303 one-kilogram gold bars worth over $40 million,](https://substack.com/redirect/85bd3689-66bc-45d1-ad72-14ca3241be6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** $2 million in currency and 35 luxury watches allegedly accumulated through false claims of needing bullion for "work-related expenses" between November 2025 and March 2026.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/85bd3689-66bc-45d1-ad72-14ca3241be6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **An affidavit indicates Rush lied about his military and academic background** during his hiring process before obtaining top-secret security clearance in 2009, prompting former CIA operations officer Tracy Walder to question how such deception escaped the agency's rigorous vetting procedures. Walder suspects Rush either forged documents or exploited a negligent background investigator who missed red flags.
* **Walder dismisses possibility of intentional undercover operation, questions security clearance integrity** : Despite theorizing Rush's actions might represent deliberate CIA surveillance, Walder dismissed the hypothesis given the "spectacle" of the public FBI raid, expressing frustration that vetting failures allowing Rush through suggest other unvetted operatives may be "flying under the radar" within intelligence community.

TX-15 is winnable, but it won’t happen on its own.
#
Peter,
In many of the nation’s most competitive districts, Latino voters will be the margin of victory in November, and Republicans know it.
That’s why we’re going all-in on voter registration and turnout in districts where the path to victory runs through Latino communities. We can change the outcome of the election and help flip the House.
One of the biggest battleground districts, **with Latinos making up 71% of the electorate, is Texas’s 15th Congressional District** — where Republican incumbent Monica De La Cruz will face Democrat Bobby Pulido this November.
[**If you’re ready to power our voter registration and mobilization work in TX-15, rush a contribution of $3 right now.**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260529-1-ak.r1ZNuo&amount=3&refcode=em20260529-189&t=1&akid=189%2E1366028%2EbWY25-)
TX-15 has become one of the most contested districts in the country. Monica De La Cruz flipped it in 2022, ending over a century of Democratic representation. Now, voters are paying the price — soaring housing costs, rising gas prices, and unaffordable essentials. They're seeing right through De La Cruz's empty promises, and they're ready for change. This is a district ripe for the taking — but only with your support.

If Monica De La Cruz stays in power, she will keep doing what she has done in Washington so far — voting like a GOP puppet, no matter the cost for the people she represents.
**She’s cut health coverage for _65,000 of her constituents_ , backed Trump’s economic agenda, and voted to endanger food access for over _260,000 families_ in her district.**
And this year, when three mariachi brothers and their parents from her district were detained by ICE after following the law and showing up for a routine check-in, _De La Cruz failed to act until constituents and the national spotlight forced her hand._
Tejano music superstar Bobby Pulido is a South Texas cultural icon and small business owner who grew up in the Rio Grande Valley. He’s running to put South Texas families first, and he’s doing what Monica De La Cruz rarely does, which is showing up across the district, listening to people directly, and building an agenda shaped by them.
TX-15 is winnable, but it won’t happen on its own. That’s why Voto Latino is working to register eligible Latino voters and mobilize new and existing voters all the way through November.

Thank you,
Voto Latino

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. | | | Hi, DSCC Vice Chair Mark Kelly here. I want to talk to you about a _key_ opportunity in front of us as we fight for the Senate majority: **special elections.**

I know a thing or two about these kinds of races, because I got to the Senate by _winning_ a special election back in 2020 – even as Republicans spent over $70 million to stop me. **And my victory proved mission‐critical, because without it, Democrats wouldn't have had a Senate majority.**

[**Now, history could repeat itself. Two special elections coming up in Ohio and Florida are among a small handful of races that could decide the majority – again. So I'm coming to ask you, will you donate $7 to win races like those and take back the Senate? >>**](https://go.dscc.org/go/23030?amount=7&t=21&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260529-MARKKELLY-KellySpecialElectionsFRV2-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260529-MARKKELLY-KellySpecialElectionsFRV2-Pros-sl1&akid=24022%2E9716520%2EHECcwo)
